properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 for Mission Bay's block-by-block reconciliation pass, cross-checking OCII's own numbered Land Use Map (Dec 2019, data/manual/_reference/mission_bay_land_use_map_2019.png) against everything already tracked: 550 Terry A. Francois Blvd, a 6-story Class A office building built 2002; longtime Gap Inc./Old Navy corporate headquarters, purchased by DivcoWest from Gap in May 2022, then subleased to OpenAI in 2024 (reported as San Francisco's largest office lease that year). 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: corrected the description above. The Real Deal (2024-09-23) says the six-story building 'once served as Old Navy's headquarters' and that DivcoWest bought it from parent company Gap in 2022; REBusinessOnline (2022-05-25) says it 'recently served the headquarters of fashion retailer Old Navy'. Neither calls it the 'longtime' or the 'Gap Inc. corporate' headquarters, so read the earlier text as: a former Old Navy headquarters, owned by parent company Gap until DivcoWest bought it in 2022. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has Assessor lot 8721011 (7,486 m2, active, mapped 2001-03-20); the earlier outline of 5,216 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.69 (99% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 69% of the lot). The outline is now that lot using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). geometry_type stays 'real'.
